description: Processing of GDPR Art. 9 special categories of personal data — health, biometrics for unique identification, racial or ethnic origin, political opinions, religion, trade-union membership, sex life or sexual orientation. Routes to ASK (a lawful Art. 9(2) basis must be confirmed). Illustrative only; synthetic text.

positives.text: Store each customer's health conditions and medication list to tailor their insurance offer.
Record and analyse applicants' religion and ethnicity fields to adjust the model.
Speichere die Gesundheitszustände und Medikamentenliste jedes Kunden, um das Versicherungsangebot anzupassen.
Erfasse und analysiere die Felder Religion und Ethnie der Antragsteller, um das Modell anzupassen.

hard_negatives.text: Store the customer's account number, balance and transaction history only.
Speichere nur Kontonummer, Saldo und Transaktionshistorie des Kunden.
